controls.stick_direction: the closed form OVERSTATES the force and UNDERSTATES the pad's travel — conservative for the seam and the pad's travel; the CTE flip thresholds move by a fraction of a ppm/K with it

verdict: Seam, adverse corner (the tightest part at μ 0.4, `87`'s upper-whisker shift reversed): `86`'s requirement on Ta is 1.03 at a quarter of the shift and 1.37 at half, and from share 0.59 the liner wall's cap binds — the wall reaches its 23 °C yield every sway cycle and the requirement is `87`'s ceiling reading, 1.48; on Ti-6Al-4V 0.34 · 0.47 → 0.55 from share 0.72. Gentle corner (the nominal part after creep at μ 0.1, the median shift one-sided): Ta 0.47–0.58, Ti-6Al-4V 0.17–0.21 over shares 0.25–1 — above `86`'s 0.3883 on Ta at every share above zero. A seasonal preload at the hot edge (55 °C) on the relaxed liner adds 15.1–48.4 N of mean on Ta (gentle to adverse grip) — up to 91 % of the wall's 23 °C yield, where creep is not modelled, so the upper end is a ceiling — and raises its requirement to 0.64 with no sway at all. Pad: the wire's own stretch is capped with the force — at most 12.8–29.9 µm at the wall's cap — so the rest of any shift goes into the pad: with the part gripping 67–88 % of a sway shift reaches it, on a part at the window floor 92–99 %, and at the hot edge a floor part grips with 0.00 N/mm. Heat, on the free-sleeve reading (the wood holding nothing): the sleeve grows 0.69–1.23 µm/K over the wire; at the cold edge the pad protrudes at least 20.0 µm on every part and grip against `90`'s isothermal L1 margin to the upper edge of 11.8–14.8 µm, and at the hot edge a floor part recedes 18.4–43.0 µm against 17.4–19.4 µm to the lower edge (past the larger in 3 of 4); on the shipped span at the capsule edge even the tightest grip recedes 26.3 µm. With a bonded anode and the flange on the bark the span follows the wood's radial expansion instead, and the cold result holds while its effective CTE stays above 25.2–25.7 ppm/K (38.0–39.0 if a Zone-3 fit locates the flange and only the gap follows the wood), the hot one above 25.9–31.4 (free PEEK 47; a «holds while above X» threshold rounds up); the wood's radial CTE is not in `102` (`103` takes xylem's). The sleeve is 12× stiffer axially than the wire at the adverse share-1 point and 4.0× at the first micron, so the wire adds between a twelfth and a quarter to the anchor's stiffness and does not set the share.
